## G-001 goal tracking
Parent project goal#6; ACTIVE milestone1 under D-021, independent of pending P-001 adoption. Objective is the concrete outcome above. Acceptance: N1-01–08. Dependency: Issues3,4,5.
Work-unit loop: next unmet criterion → required review → test → minimum implementation → verify → evidence/commit/push → evaluate objective and parent contribution → next. Checkpoint records candidate/version, outcome/evidence, limitation/blocker, plan impact (none/within-scope/change proposal) and next action. Close only after objective verification, not child closure/model opinion. Material plan changes require Opus agreement and actual human finalization; routine approved-scope choices remain autonomous.
